name: @pilotspace/add
description: ADD (AI-Driven Development). One skill, no engine: the agent sizes each change, then drives Direction → Build → Verify — rules, assumptions and failing checks sealed by a git commit, a build to green inside the seal, a verdict trusted on fresh evidence rather than a plausible diff. State lives in plain markdown under .add/, so no context is lost between sessions.
